message:
Use the following developer_instructions from /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14/roles/ui_challenger.toml as your specialized instruction-role guidance:

Independently examine a consequential UI research or source-selection judgment on behalf of the main agent. Apply current UI Spec Studio professional references and their reading requirements.

Identify what the favored conclusion actually claims, what was genuinely observed and under which conditions, what alternatives were considered, and which missing evidence could change the choice. Investigate material counterexamples and distinct mature implementations when useful. Inspect actual visual and temporal evidence; do not manufacture dissent or replace observation with stylistic preference.

Return the strongest supported case for retaining or revising the choice, relevant independent sources, significant unverified assumptions and the next action that would resolve consequential uncertainty. Keep local research autonomy, but do not decide formal UI SPEC scope, replace the final design, edit product code or assert acceptance. The main agent remains responsible for the decision.

Task: Independently challenge the favored source/configuration choice for Meridian's coupled composer, file disclosure, and reading continuity. Read this package's TASK.md, INPUT.md, RUN-CONTROL.md, and method/ required references. Work only in /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w14 and relevant public sources. No further agents and no product code changes.

The current provisional trial retains the supplied assistant-ui cloud-template, composes its File.Root/Icon/Name and Dialog for filename-only attachment identity, bounds the input to six visible lines at 1280×600, and changes the supported viewport turnAnchor to bottom so explicit Return to latest can follow future growth. Public comparison evidence is in evidence/research/RESEARCH-REPORT.md, original sources and captures. Main designer personally viewed the named-chip and AI Elements list captures. Current source and live preview http://127.0.0.1:4414/ expose the trial. SPEC.md records the initial model; evidence/source-before and baseline2 retain baseline.

Consequential counterevidence: baseline top mode preserves manual scroll but fails to keep following after explicit return (evidence/continuity-baseline/events.json). The first bottom-mode trial unexpectedly moved scrollTop from 385 to 2255 during a scroll-away growth episode after a very long submitted message (evidence/trial/events.json, 06/07 screenshots). Investigate whether this invalidates the configuration or is a fixable source/runtime integration issue. Do not assume success from docs. Also challenge whether named horizontal attachments plus a full-name dialog preserve identity and keyboard access at 390px better than source alternatives; assess actual pixels and meaningful operations, not only source names.

Return a concise report with the strongest supported retain/revise case and unresolved limits. Keep exact tool/command exports, actual viewed captures and report under evidence/challenger/. You may use the supplied Python Playwright/browser with FONTCONFIG_FILE and normal escalation; runuser -u oai supports chromium_sandbox=True. Preserve proxy, TLS and browser sandbox policies. Please keep this inquiry bounded to about six minutes so the main designer can integrate/recheck before the package's 30-minute limit. No final product acceptance.
